name: bm-changed
description: S→C bm.changed push (protocol 1.6, phase 11): folder + link + locked + truncated BmEl round trip. The first element is a locked bookmarks-bar folder carrying an unknown `future` field that must be IGNORED on decode (D-05, dropped on canonical re-encode); the second is a plain link proving every optional key (folder/count/locked/truncated) stays ABSENT on re-encode; the third is a truncated folder. The snapshot-level `truncated` flag is preserved. There is no `url` and no `icon` field anywhere — the locked no-url invariant (SPEC §7) plus D-07.
